summary: Learn to create effective evaluation frameworks for social protection systems. Join our training course and empower your career in social development!
lede: Designing Evaluation Frameworks for Social Protection Systems helps you build credible evaluation approaches that reveal who is reached, who is excluded, what drives performance, and where risks such as leakage or inefficiency may arise. You will learn to connect program logic, outcomes, indicators, evaluation questions, data quality controls, and evidence users. The course turns ad-hoc reporting into a structured system for learning and accountability. It prepares practitioners to interpret findings, manage learning loops, and produce useful evaluation products despite limited budgets, data gaps, political pressure, fragmented systems, and tight timelines.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for evaluating and improving social protection systems. It is ideal for those involved in designing, implementing, and managing social programs across various sectors.
audience: Government social protection and safety net program
NGO program leads in cash transfers, protection
Auditors, compliance teams, and accountability professionals
modules: Foundations of Evaluating Social Protection Systems
Defining Purpose, Scope, and Evaluation Use
Building Program Logic Models That Reflect Reality
Designing Evaluation Questions That Drive Action
Indicators That Measure Protection, Not Just Activity
Measurement Strategy and Data Source Planning
Sampling, Ethics, and Field Operations for Credible Evidence
Data Quality Assurance and QA/QC for Evaluations
Interpreting Findings and Turning Evidence Into Decisions
Evaluating System Components and Delivery Chains
Reporting, Communication, and Managing Sensitive Results
Learning Loops, Adaptive Management, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of social protection systems and prior experience in program management or evaluation. Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools is beneficial.
